thread:
Maria: Quick capture — ran three onboarding calls this morning and spotted a cluster of small product asks that keep coming up. dumping them here so we can prioritize quickly.

Maria: TL;DR: three 'small' requests (low build effort) but at least one is a near-term renewal blocker.

Maria: 1) TailwindHR — they want a set of pre-built prompt templates per vertical in the console (marketing, support, recruiter). Customers expect a one-click ‘use this prompt’ to speed trial evaluation.

Maria: 2) LumenPay — asks for CSV export of embedding similarity scores for internal auditing. They want to attach outputs to compliance docs.

Maria: 3) Northbay (renewal in 3w) — wants a lightweight onboarding checklist in the Console that shows required steps and a status badge they can share with internal stakeholders.

Devon: these all read like 1–3 day tickets if we scope narrowly. can we batch as `tiny-asks` and push a quick sprint?

Josiah: +1. I can sketch a simple console mock for the prompt templates and checklist. for exports we might reuse existing CSV exporter.

Kelly: Northbay is the one I'm worried about — they're flagged at risk if we don't show clear onboarding progress. can we tag that as renewal-impact? :warning:

Priya: Enablement can ship a short playbook for TailwindHR immediately (templated prompts + examples) if the console UI isn't ready. that buys time.

Maria: Proposed priority: Northbay (high, renewal), TailwindHR (medium, helps conversion), LumenPay (low-medium, compliance ask). agree?

Devon: agree. I'll create three lightweight issues and tag them `tiny-asks` + `cs-priority`. can someone confirm acceptance criteria?

Josiah: Acceptance criteria suggestions:
```
- TailwindHR prompt templates: UI card + 6 starter prompts + copy examples in help center
- LumenPay CSV export: endpoint + one-click export in UI, header columns: id, query, embedding_score, timestamp
- Northbay checklist: checklist flow + shareable status badge, ability to mark steps complete
```

Kelly: That looks good. for Northbay we also need an ETA to share with customer. can we aim for a 10-business-day turnaround?

Devon: I'll estimate dev effort today and post PRD link. if it's really tiny we can do 5 business days for the checklist.

feedback-bot: Created ticket CS-10234, CS-10235, CS-10236 and assigned to @devon. Added label: tiny-asks, cs-priority. https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-10234

Maria: Nice — can we also keep a single shared doc with short copy snippets so enablement and CS can publish quickly? I can start a Google doc and drop links in the ticket.

Priya: I'll draft the TailwindHR playbook today and link it. :memo:

Josiah: I'll put minimal mockups in the PRD and mark the checklist as highest priority inside this group.

Maria: Awesome. follow-ups: Devon posts estimates by EOD, Kelly echoes ETA to Northbay, Priya publishes playbook draft. thanks team! :rocket:
